evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.9 ppm after remaining approximately 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen rose to 20.3 ppm during growth, following 6.7 ppm at 2520 s and 13.4 ppm at 2640 s.
Oxygen continued rising to 33.3 ppm, up from 25.9 ppm at 2880 s, inconsistent with the established purged baseline.
Temperature is 750.1 °C against 750 °C setpoint, argon is 100.5 sccm against 100 sccm, pressure is stable at 760.6 Torr, and status remains running; these do not explain the oxygen increase.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak/inlet-gas checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, contaminated supply, outgassing, and sensor error; a seal leak is not yet uniquely identified. Sample characterization is not yet available.
